summary: This is an 8-K filing announcing the publication of clinical and translational results from a Phase 1 trial of VCN-01 in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. The report details trial arms, patient enrollment, and outcomes such as progression-free and overall survival. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. This is a routine current report on clinical data, not a special situation.
